summary.headline: Radico Khaitan Q4 FY26: EBITDA margin hit record 19% (+565 bps YoY) on IMFL volume +4%; FY27 guidance of 120-125 bps margin expansion reiterated.
summary.overview: FY26 crossed two milestones: net revenue above INR 6,000 crore and EBITDA above INR 1,000 crore. Q4 IMFL volume rose 4% YoY to 9.52 million cases, with Prestige & Above (P&A) volume up 28%, while regular volume declined on a higher base and policy changes in Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka. Gross margin reached 48% (+450 bps YoY, +150 bps QoQ) and EBITDA margin 19% (+565 bps YoY), the highest ever for the company. Net debt fell by INR 329 crore in the year, and management expects to be debt-free in H1 FY27.

financial_highlights.change: Top line grew about 25% in FY26 (per CFO)

segments.name: Prestige & Above (P&A)
segments.commentary: Q4 volume +28% YoY; FY26 growth stated as 28% in one answer. Luxury portfolio at INR 475 crore FY26 sales value, targeted to grow about 25% in value in FY27.

segments.name: Magic Moments Vodka
segments.commentary: FY26 volume +21% to 8.6 million cases and about INR 1,500 crore sales value; Q4 growth 28% YoY, supported by new flavours (Jamun, Mango, Thandai).

segments.name: After Dark Whisky
segments.commentary: FY26 growth over 60% (about 62% per management), crossing 3.1 million cases.

segments.name: Royal Ranthambore Whisky
segments.commentary: FY26 growth over 50%, driven by civil and CSD channels.

segments.name: Regular segment
segments.commentary: Q4 volume declined on higher base and policy changes; FY26 regular volume grew about 30% per management. FY27 volume guidance 3-5%.

segments.name: Non-IMFL / bulk spirit
segments.commentary: Growing 7-8% naturally; about 30% of top line, with bulk spirit increasingly consumed captively.

guidance_outlook: FY27 EBITDA margin expansion of 120-125 bps on an annualised basis, including about 60 bps from state price increases and over 200 bps from premiumisation and operating leverage, net of cost push.
FY27 luxury portfolio value growth of about 25% from INR 475 crore base.
FY27 regular segment volume growth of 3-5%.
Realisation gap between volume and value growth expected at 300-400 bps in aggregate as luxury outgrows P&A.
Marketing spend to stay in a 6-8% of sales bracket.
Capex of INR 150-175 crore in FY27, mainly internal capacity expansion and optimisation.
Expected to be debt-free in H1 FY27; minimum dividend payout of 20% of PAT; no acquisitions planned, organic growth preferred.
capex_capacity: Bottling: about 60-65% outsourced via lease/tie-up arrangements; 30-35% handled in own plants. Radico procures all raw material for tie-up units.
FY27 capex guided at INR 150-175 crore, largely internal capacity expansion and optimisation; management says capacity is not a constraint for 20% P&A growth.
Power and fuel at Sitapur and Rampur plants about 90% biofuel-driven; both plants described as self-sufficient on captive basis.
New Jaisalmer-type/Virasat single malt distillery stillhouse opened at Rampur in February 2026 (opening referenced during Jim Murray visit).
Luxury brands Virasat and The Spirit of Kashmyr in 10 states; target 20 states in FY27.
Maharashtra JV (RNV) with MML: management aims for about 10% market share in MML category; JV described as self-sufficient, no further investment needed.
demand_pricing: Seven to eight states have already granted price increases; further talks ongoing with state governments (cost push cited).
Karnataka: prior premium-brand price rationalisation drove premium growth about a year and a half ago; management expects a similar second step but no official policy yet.
West Bengal now an open market with private retail; strategy to be set after policy clarity. Bihar prohibition uplift is watched but not confirmed.
Glass prices up about 15% in the last month; factored into costing. Hipster PET pack gaining momentum and reducing glass dependence.
US tariff at 10%; management says impact not material for luxury (retail price difference of USD 5-6 per bottle), though US market softer.
Maharashtra: IMFL industry fell 20-25% after MML introduction; Maharashtra is 3-4% of business.
UP IMFL market share about 24-26% (UPML and UPCL combined); management states No.1 position in UP for FY26.
Top three states by salience: Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (with Telangana, Karnataka), and Rajasthan.
International share of revenue about 8-9%; present in 50-plus airports with target of 100 airports.

qa_highlights.question: New product launches for FY27 in P&A and luxury, and how the 125 bps margin will absorb commodity costs?
qa_highlights.answer: Focus on consolidating three to four luxury/P&A launches nationally (Virasat, Kashmyr to 20 states from 10), more Magic flavours, and Tequila under D'YAVOL by year-end. Margin: 60 bps from price increases plus over 200 bps from premiumisation and operating leverage cover cost push; guidance is annualised.

qa_highlights.question: Will marketing spend unlock given fewer launches?
qa_highlights.answer: No stated unlock; marketing kept within 6-8% of sales depending on launches and flagships. Higher top line means higher absolute marketing spend.

qa_highlights.question: Karnataka pricing, West Bengal, Bihar prohibition?
qa_highlights.answer: Karnataka second price rationalisation expected but not announced; West Bengal too early, open market now; Bihar to be watched with upside if prohibition eased.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 125 bps margin guidance inclusive of India-UK FTA benefit, and what about export impact from US tariffs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says 125 bps is inclusive of all factors, with pluses and minuses; US tariff at 10% not material for luxury, US market softer.

qa_highlights.question: How will 20% P&A volume growth be supported in capacity and outsourced supply?
qa_highlights.answer: About 60-65% bottling outsourced; Radico supplies all raw material; capex INR 150-175 crore; capacity not a constraint.

qa_highlights.question: Realisation growth and regular segment outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Volume-value delta expected at 300-400 bps; regular volume guided at 3-5% for FY27 after 30% FY26 growth.

qa_highlights.question: Global strategy and GenZ / low-alcohol plans?
qa_highlights.answer: No plans for low-alcohol or RTD for now; focus on white spirits and flavours. International share 8-9% and falling as domestic grows faster.

qa_highlights.question: Maharashtra JV and UP market position?
qa_highlights.answer: JV self-sufficient with cash generation, no further investment; aiming about 10% MML share. Radico is No.1 in UP IMFL with about 24-26% share.

risks_watch: West Asia developments affecting input costs, LPG availability and glass supply; management says a drastic deterioration could hit the 120-125 bps margin target.
Glass price inflation (about 15% recently) and shift to PET/hipster packs.
Dependence on outsourced bottling (60-65%) for supply continuity.
Karnataka second-step pricing and Bihar prohibition decisions remain unconfirmed.
Maharashtra IMFL volume decline after MML launch; JV stabilisation to be tracked.
Regular segment volume decline in Q4; FY27 guidance only 3-5%.
US export softness; India-UK FTA benefit not quantified.
Achieving 25% luxury growth and 20% P&A volume growth after strong FY26 base.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on FY26 results and FY27 targets, with repeated caution on West Asia-related cost and supply risks. Management was evasive on specifics for Karnataka, West Bengal, Bihar and the UK FTA, saying policies are not yet out.
key_quotes: During the year, we crossed two key milestones with net revenue exceeding INR 6,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR 1,000 crores.
EBITDA margin during the quarter stood at 19%, expanding 565 basis points year-on-year, highest ever EBITDA margin.
As far as the tie -up unit goes, all the material is procured by Radico, they are only converting it.
So, 125 basis points should be delivered given the current scenario.

adds.what: Single malt distillery stillhouse at Rampur (Virasat single malt), opened February 2026
Internal capacity expansion and optimisation, INR 150-175 cr capex FY27 (no unit capacity numbers given)

growth.why: FY27 guidance: P&A volume +20%, luxury value +25% from INR 475 cr, regular volume +3-5%, and 120-125 bps EBITDA margin expansion; backed mainly by premiumisation, price increases in 7-8 states and a 150-175 cr capex plan, but no quantified capacity additions, and the brief's revenue growth figure is not a clear FY27 guide.
